mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over the last three months suggests an improving labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as businesses and investors anticipate a slowdown in economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS is high relative to GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last month signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in the last month, during a period of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%), signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS < 1%
regime_hint: low interest rate environment with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS was below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong demand in the housing market and a healthy labor market, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST is high relative to UNRATE.
